CFML Language Reference: Functions

LCase

Returns a copy of the string with all uppercase letters converted to lowercase.

Category

String functions

Syntax

LCase(string)

Parameters

string
The string to convert.

Returns

The string in lowercase.

Usage

Handy for normalizing e-mail addresses and file names before storing or comparing them. UCase goes the other way.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="GetPeople" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets" MAXROWS="5">
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employees ORDER BY LastName
</CFQUERY>
<P>Suggested login names:</P>
<UL>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="GetPeople">
<LI>#FirstName# #LastName#: #LCase(Left(FirstName, 1) & LastName)#
</CFOUTPUT>
</UL>
